notes:
Planning Center Sync 0.6.0: full control over what shows for each event

- Show or hide the description, Register button, location and map, rooms and end time: site-wide on the Settings tab, and per event on its edit screen.
- Keep the website's version of the title, date and time, graphic, location or categories for one event. Untick to hand it back to Planning Center.
- Choose the description per event: Planning Center summary, Planning Center description, or your own text.
- Fallback graphic (a default, and one per category) for events with no graphic in Planning Center.
- Tags tab: mark a tag to approve its events automatically.
- Set how many upcoming dates to keep for one repeating event.
- Edit in Planning Center links, and a Dashboard box showing whether the sync is healthy.
- Reads every published event, not only the first 100.
